name: axum

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: no Dockerfile, Procfile or platform manifest; the only workflow builds and tests in CI and deploys nothing

processes.note: nothing declares the process; the binary connects to Postgres, runs migrations and serves HTTP (src/http/mod.rs)

data.note: sqlx PgPoolOptions on DATABASE_URL (.env.sample names it); schema in migrations/

notes: A single-binary Realworld API: src/main.rs reads config from env (clap), opens a Postgres pool, runs embedded migrations at startup (sqlx::migrate!) and serves axum routes. Every file under src/ was read; there are no timers, queues, disk writes, sessions (JWT auth) or websockets, and tokio::task::spawn_blocking in src/http/users.rs is awaited inside the request. Migrations on startup are not a release step, so nothing is listed in breaks, but concurrent first starts race on them and a reviewer may prefer a Cloud Run job. No rule includes a file here that would fire (Rust has only local-disk-write), so notBreaks is empty; the CI workflow uses a Postgres container only for tests.
